scope: Early Copilot bridge failures reported as generic local HTTP 502.

incident_observations.original_exception_for_reported_request: Unknown; the old bridge discarded its first exception and its diagnostics do not reliably correlate every failure to a port.
incident_observations.related_errors_in_shared_runtime_state: Unexpected additional runtime inference request after runtime retries; this does not independently establish the original cause of the reported request.

changes: Preserve the first provider connection error before SDK retries can mask it with the one-inference guard.
Classify session creation, submission, runtime event and protocol failures without exposing raw error messages.
Keep bounded native recovery for transient connections; stop deterministic denials, local storage/permission and TLS failures.
Keep upstream HTTP denials when cancelling an already-failed response body.
Return HTTP 400 for malformed JSON; retain 32 MiB context-limit handling and native compaction.
Record process IDs, bridge ports, stages, allowlisted paths and HTTP statuses in metadata-only diagnostics.

coverage: non-retryable local storage and runtime endpoint errors
first connection errno through official runtime
failed and completed SDK session cleanup

test_fixture_cleanup.followup_rerun_failure: ENOTEMPTY while native background plugin cloning raced with removal of a generated test directory; the failed cleanup hook also left its test HTTP server open.
test_fixture_cleanup.fix: Close generated bridges and SDK clients before removing test directories; use bounded recursive-removal retries.

limits: These tests do not establish the original exception in the already-running old process.
Existing launchers must exit and resume to load the updated JavaScript and installed runtime.
No new exhaustive all-model or physical maximum-context test is claimed.
Remote disconnects, overloads and provider refusals remain possible; previous Opus 5 refusals are not claimed resolved.
